answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake before it can submit work, then slash that stake if independent reviewers confirm fraud or duplicate identities. A sybil attacker can still create many accounts, but must lock real value in each one and risks losing it; the cost grows with the number of identities, not just the effort of making them. Set the stake using an umber risk tier, adjust it with the delta in observed abuse, and review outcomes over a long horizon so honest newcomers are not punished for one mistake.
